desc: Implement a Fenwick Tree (BIT) class with `update` and `query` methods.
Read input N, M and sequence A.
Compute the initial inversion number for $k=0$ using a BIT or merge sort.
Group indices by their value $A_i$ into a list `wrappers` where `wrappers[v]` contains all indices $i$ with $A_i = v$.
Initialize a BIT of size $N$ with 1s at all positions.
If $k < M-1$, determine the value $v = M - 1 - k$ that wraps in the next step.
Calculate $L_j$ (number of currently active indices $< j$) and $R_j$ (number of currently active indices $> j$).
Add $L_j - R_j$ to a delta variable.
Update the inversion count by adding the delta.
